events.text: Goal! Atletico Madrid 1, Manchester United 0. Pablo Barrios (Atletico Madrid) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Álex Baena.
First Half ends, Atletico Madrid 1, Manchester United 0.
Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Atletico Madrid. Marc Pubill replaces Pablo Barrios.
Substitution, Atletico Madrid. Jonathan David replaces Lee Kang-In.
Substitution, Manchester United. Joshua Zirkzee replaces Youri Tielemans.
Substitution, Manchester United. Mason Mount replaces Carlos Baleba.
Substitution, Manchester United. Amad Diallo replaces Marcus Rashford.
Substitution, Atletico Madrid. Ademola Lookman replaces Álex Baena.
Substitution, Atletico Madrid. Morten Hjulmand replaces Julián Alvarez.
Leny Yoro (Manchester United) is shown the red card.
Goal! Atletico Madrid 2, Manchester United 0. Ademola Lookman (Atletico Madrid) right footed shot from very close range to the bottom left corner following a fast break.
Substitution, Manchester United. Harry Maguire replaces Ayden Heaven.
Substitution, Manchester United. Matheus Cunha replaces Bruno Fernandes.
Substitution, Atletico Madrid. Robin Le Normand replaces Giuliano Simeone.
Robin Le Normand (Atletico Madrid) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Second Half ends, Atletico Madrid 2, Manchester United 0.
